=== an interrupt vector table with jmp
        .text
        .globl  __vectors
__vectors:
        jmp     __init
        jmp     __vector_1
        jmp     __vector_2
        jmp     __bad_interrupt
        .weak   __vector_1
        .set    __vector_1, __bad_interrupt
__vector_2:
        push    r1
        push    r0
        in      r0, 0x3f
        push    r0
        clr     r1
        call    handler
        pop     r0
        out     0x3f, r0
        pop     r0
        pop     r1
        reti
__bad_interrupt:
        jmp     __vectors
__init: clr     r1
        out     0x3f, r1
        ldi     r28, 0xff
        ldi     r29, 0x08
        out     0x3e, r29
        out     0x3d, r28
        call    main
        jmp     _exit
handler:
        ret
main:   ret
_exit:  cli
1:      rjmp    1b
=== an 8x8 and a 16x16 multiply
        .text
mul8:   mul     r24, r22
        movw    r24, r0
        clr     r1
        ret
muls8:  muls    r24, r22
        movw    r24, r0
        clr     r1
        ret
mul16:  movw    r26, r24
        mul     r26, r22
        movw    r18, r0
        mul     r27, r22
        add     r19, r0
        mul     r26, r23
        add     r19, r0
        clr     r1
        movw    r24, r18
        ret
fixed:  fmul    r16, r17
        fmuls   r18, r19
        fmulsu  r20, r21
        mulsu   r22, r23
        ret
=== reading far program memory with elpm and RAMPZ
RAMPZ = 0x3b
        .text
far:    ldi     r24, hh8(table)
        out     RAMPZ, r24
        ldi     r30, lo8(table)
        ldi     r31, hi8(table)
        elpm    r24, Z+
        elpm    r25, Z
        elpm
        ret
table:  .word   0x1234
=== self-programming, as a bootloader does
SPMCSR = 0x37
        .text
write:  movw    r30, r24
        ldi     r18, 0x05
        sts     0x57, r18
        spm
        ldi     r18, 0x03
        out     SPMCSR, r18
        spm
        break
        wdr
        sleep
        ret
=== calls through function pointers
        .text
        .globl  run
run:    ldi     r30, lo8(pm(target))
        ldi     r31, hi8(pm(target))
        icall
        ldi     r30, lo8(gs(target))
        ldi     r31, hi8(gs(target))
        ijmp
target: ret
ptrs:   .word   gs(target), pm(run)
=== clang -O1 for the atmega328p
__tmp_reg__ = 0
__zero_reg__ = 1
__SREG__ = 63
__SP_H__ = 62
__SP_L__ = 61
	.file	"prog1.c"
	.text
	.globl	__vector_16                     ; -- Begin function __vector_16
	.p2align	1
	.type	__vector_16,@function
__vector_16:                            ; @__vector_16
; %bb.0:
	push	r0
	in	r0, 63
	push	r0
	push	r24
	push	r25
	lds	r24, ticks
	lds	r25, ticks+1
	adiw	r24, 1
	sts	ticks+1, r25
	sts	ticks, r24
	pop	r25
	pop	r24
	pop	r0
	out	63, r0
	pop	r0
	reti
.Lfunc_end0:
	.size	__vector_16, .Lfunc_end0-__vector_16
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	puts_                           ; -- Begin function puts_
	.p2align	1
	.type	puts_,@function
puts_:                                  ; @puts_
; %bb.0:
	movw	r30, r24
	ld	r24, Z
	cpi	r24, 0
	breq	.LBB1_3
.LBB1_1:                                ; =>This Inner Loop Header: Depth=1
	lds	r25, 192
	andi	r25, 32
	cpi	r25, 0
	breq	.LBB1_1
; %bb.2:                                ;   in Loop: Header=BB1_1 Depth=1
	sts	198, r24
	movw	r26, r30
	adiw	r26, 1
	ldd	r24, Z+1
	cpi	r24, 0
	movw	r30, r26
	brne	.LBB1_1
.LBB1_3:
	ret
.Lfunc_end1:
	.size	puts_, .Lfunc_end1-puts_
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	mul32                           ; -- Begin function mul32
	.p2align	1
	.type	mul32,@function
mul32:                                  ; @mul32
; %bb.0:
	movw	r30, r24
	movw	r26, r22
	movw	r22, r18
	movw	r24, r20
	movw	r18, r26
	movw	r20, r30
	call	__mulsi3
	ret
.Lfunc_end2:
	.size	mul32, .Lfunc_end2-mul32
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	div16                           ; -- Begin function div16
	.p2align	1
	.type	div16,@function
div16:                                  ; @div16
; %bb.0:
	cp	r22, r1
	cpc	r23, r1
	breq	.LBB3_2
; %bb.1:
	call	__udivmodhi4
	movw	r24, r22
	ret
.LBB3_2:
	ldi	r24, 255
	ldi	r25, 255
	ret
.Lfunc_end3:
	.size	div16, .Lfunc_end3-div16
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	classify                        ; -- Begin function classify
	.p2align	1
	.type	classify,@function
classify:                               ; @classify
; %bb.0:
	cpi	r24, 7
	cpc	r25, r1
	brlo	.LBB4_2
; %bb.1:
	ldi	r24, 255
	ldi	r25, 255
	ret
.LBB4_2:
	adiw	r24, 10
	ret
.Lfunc_end4:
	.size	classify, .Lfunc_end4-classify
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	run                             ; -- Begin function run
	.p2align	1
	.type	run,@function
run:                                    ; @run
; %bb.0:
	ldi	r18, pm_lo8(nothing)
	ldi	r19, pm_hi8(nothing)
	sts	handlers+7, r19
	sts	handlers+6, r18
	ldi	r20, pm_lo8(blink)
	ldi	r21, pm_hi8(blink)
	sts	handlers+5, r21
	sts	handlers+4, r20
	sts	handlers+3, r19
	sts	handlers+2, r18
	sts	handlers+1, r21
	sts	handlers, r20
	andi	r24, 3
	mov	r30, r24
	clr	r31
	lsl	r30
	rol	r31
	subi	r30, lo8(-(handlers))
	sbci	r31, hi8(-(handlers))
	ld	r24, Z
	ldd	r25, Z+1
	movw	r30, r24
	icall
	ret
.Lfunc_end5:
	.size	run, .Lfunc_end5-run
                                        ; -- End function
	.p2align	1                               ; -- Begin function blink
	.type	blink,@function
blink:                                  ; @blink
; %bb.0:
	ldi	r24, 32
	in	r25, 5
	eor	r25, r24
	out	5, r25
	ret
.Lfunc_end6:
	.size	blink, .Lfunc_end6-blink
                                        ; -- End function
	.p2align	1                               ; -- Begin function nothing
	.type	nothing,@function
nothing:                                ; @nothing
; %bb.0:
	ret
.Lfunc_end7:
	.size	nothing, .Lfunc_end7-nothing
                                        ; -- End function
	.globl	main                            ; -- Begin function main
	.p2align	1
	.type	main,@function
main:                                   ; @main
; %bb.0:
	push	r2
	push	r3
	push	r4
	push	r5
	push	r6
	push	r7
	push	r8
	push	r9
	push	r10
	push	r11
	push	r12
	push	r13
	push	r14
	push	r15
	push	r16
	push	r17
	sbi	4, 5
	ldi	r24, lo8(msg)
	ldi	r25, hi8(msg)
	ldi	r18, 104
.LBB8_1:                                ; =>This Inner Loop Header: Depth=1
	lds	r19, 192
	andi	r19, 32
	cpi	r19, 0
	breq	.LBB8_1
; %bb.2:                                ;   in Loop: Header=BB8_1 Depth=1
	sts	198, r18
	movw	r30, r24
	ldd	r18, Z+1
	adiw	r24, 1
	cpi	r18, 0
	brne	.LBB8_1
; %bb.3:
	ldi	r24, pm_lo8(nothing)
	ldi	r25, pm_hi8(nothing)
	movw	r8, r24
	ldi	r24, pm_lo8(blink)
	ldi	r25, pm_hi8(blink)
	movw	r6, r24
	ldi	r24, 3
	ldi	r25, 0
	movw	r4, r24
	ldi	r16, 0
	ldi	r17, 0
	ldi	r24, 147
	ldi	r25, 36
	movw	r2, r24
.LBB8_4:                                ; =>This Inner Loop Header: Depth=1
	movw	r24, r8
	sts	handlers+7, r25
	sts	handlers+6, r24
	movw	r18, r6
	sts	handlers+5, r19
	sts	handlers+4, r18
	sts	handlers+3, r25
	sts	handlers+2, r24
	sts	handlers+1, r19
	sts	handlers, r18
	lds	r30, ticks
	lds	r31, ticks+1
	andi	r30, 3
	andi	r31, 0
	lsl	r30
	rol	r31
	subi	r30, lo8(-(handlers))
	sbci	r31, hi8(-(handlers))
	ld	r24, Z
	ldd	r25, Z+1
	movw	r30, r24
	icall
	lds	r22, counter
	lds	r23, counter+1
	lds	r24, counter+2
	lds	r25, counter+3
	movw	r18, r4
	movw	r20, r16
	call	__mulsi3
	movw	r14, r22
	movw	r12, r24
	lds	r10, ticks
	lds	r11, ticks+1
	movw	r22, r10
	movw	r24, r16
	movw	r18, r2
	movw	r20, r16
	call	__mulsi3
	sub	r10, r24
	sbc	r11, r25
	lsr	r11
	ror	r10
	add	r10, r24
	adc	r11, r25
	lsr	r11
	ror	r10
	lsr	r11
	ror	r10
	add	r10, r14
	adc	r11, r15
	adc	r12, r16
	adc	r13, r17
	lds	r24, ticks
	lds	r25, ticks+1
	andi	r24, 7
	andi	r25, 0
	lsl	r24
	rol	r25
	subi	r24, lo8(-(switch.table.main))
	sbci	r25, hi8(-(switch.table.main))
	movw	r30, r24
	ld	r24, Z
	ldd	r25, Z+1
	movw	r18, r24
	lsl	r19
	sbc	r19, r19
	mov	r18, r19
	add	r10, r24
	adc	r11, r25
	adc	r18, r12
	adc	r19, r13
	sts	counter+1, r11
	sts	counter, r10
	sts	counter+3, r19
	sts	counter+2, r18
	rjmp	.LBB8_4
.Lfunc_end8:
	.size	main, .Lfunc_end8-main
                                        ; -- End function
	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;copy all variables from program memory to RAM on startup
	.globl	__do_copy_data
	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;clear the zeroed data section on startup
	.globl	__do_clear_bss
	.type	counter,@object                 ; @counter
	.data
	.globl	counter
counter:
	.long	305419896                       ; 0x12345678
	.size	counter, 4

	.type	handlers,@object                ; @handlers
	.section	.bss,"aw",@nobits
	.globl	handlers
handlers:
	.zero	8
	.size	handlers, 8

	.type	ticks,@object                   ; @ticks
	.globl	ticks
ticks:
	.short	0                               ; 0x0
	.size	ticks, 2

	.type	msg,@object                     ; @msg
	.section	.progmem.data,"aMS",@progbits,1
msg:
	.asciz	"hello, world\n"
	.size	msg, 14

	.type	switch.table.main,@object       ; @switch.table.main
	.section	.rodata.cst16,"aM",@progbits,16
switch.table.main:
	.short	10                              ; 0xa
	.short	11                              ; 0xb
	.short	12                              ; 0xc
	.short	13                              ; 0xd
	.short	14                              ; 0xe
	.short	15                              ; 0xf
	.short	16                              ; 0x10
	.short	65535                           ; 0xffff
	.size	switch.table.main, 16

	.section	".note.GNU-stack","",@progbits

	sbc	r13, r25
	lsr	r13
	ror	r12
	add	r12, r24
	adc	r13, r25
	lsr	r13
	ror	r12
	lsr	r13
	ror	r12
	add	r12, r10
	adc	r13, r11
	adc	r14, r16
	adc	r15, r17
	lds	r24, ticks
	lds	r25, ticks+1
	andi	r24, 7
	andi	r25, 0
	cpi	r24, 7
	cpc	r25, r1
	movw	r18, r8
	brne	.LBB8_29
	rjmp	.LBB8_27
.LBB8_29:                               ;   in Loop: Header=BB8_28 Depth=1
	adiw	r24, 10
	movw	r18, r24
	rjmp	.LBB8_27
.Lfunc_end8:
	.size	main, .Lfunc_end8-main
                                        ; -- End function
	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;copy all variables from program memory to RAM on startup
	.globl	__do_copy_data
	; Declaring this symbol tells the CRT that it should
	;clear the zeroed data section on startup
	.globl	__do_clear_bss
	.type	counter,@object                 ; @counter
	.data
	.globl	counter
counter:
	.long	305419896                       ; 0x12345678
	.size	counter, 4

	.type	handlers,@object                ; @handlers
	.section	.bss,"aw",@nobits
	.globl	handlers
handlers:
	.zero	8
	.size	handlers, 8

	.type	ticks,@object                   ; @ticks
	.globl	ticks
ticks:
	.short	0                               ; 0x0
	.size	ticks, 2

	.section	".note.GNU-stack","",@progbits
